**The table.** Paste the share link (the Share button on the tool, or the URL of this copy with `?s=`), so the exact configuration travels with the report.

**What the tool says.**

**What you measured or expected.** The runtime (llama.cpp, LM Studio, MLX, Ollama), the file (quant label), the context length, and the number: tokens per second, or the memory you saw in Activity Monitor (say whether it is binary or decimal gigabytes).

**Source.** A public link if you are citing one.

A wrong row in the data (a machine's bandwidth or price, a benchmark) belongs in the data repository: https://github.com/alexgrankinukr-hash/llm-sizer-data. A wrong formula belongs here.
